clips.title: The story
paras: Jadefire Run is a heavily fortified satyr encampment nestled in northern Felwood. It houses some of the most powerful and cunning satyrs in the region, serving as a bastion of demonic corruption deep within the tainted forest.

Situated amid the blighted woods of northern Felwood, Jadefire Run functions as a stronghold for the Jadefire satyrs. Unlike lesser outposts scattered throughout the valley, this camp features substantial demonic construction and shelters formidable spellcasters and tricksters. The satyrs here actively conspire to spread corruption further across Kalimdor, employing dark sorcery and foul trickery against anyone who dares intrude on their territory.
